objectives_registry.title: Complete MCC Examination Objectives Registry
objectives_registry.source: MCC Examination Objectives Online Web Service

retrieval_plan.step_1: Access the technical documentation for MCC Objectives Online Web Service at https://mcc.ca/objectives/
retrieval_plan.step_3: Attempt retrieval without assuming credentials are required (API may be public)
step_4: legacy_id (when available and verified from official source)
retrieval_plan.step_5: Record any retrieval failures with: URL, HTTP status, date/time, error

mcc_id.validation: Do not invent or infer missing IDs

legacy_id.note: Only include if retrieved from separate official source with documented provenance

official_url.source: Official MCC URL for the objective

content.note: Full objective text or concise structured extraction

web_service_notes.public_endpoints: MCC publicly documents JSON/XML web-service endpoints
web_service_notes.credentials: Do not assume credentials are required - attempt documented public endpoints first
web_service_notes.failure_recording: If API endpoint fails, record: URL, HTTP status, date/time, and error message
web_service_notes.no_invention: Do not invent or infer missing objective IDs

data_integrity_notes: This registry will be populated deterministically from official MCC web service. Every field must contain provenance from official MCC sources.
